**French‑born space‑travelers who flew aboard Soyuz and were born before 1950**

| Name | Birthdate | Soyuz mission(s) flown |
|------|-----------|------------------------|
| **Jean‑Loup Chrétien** | 20 Aug 1938 | Soyuz T‑6 (24 Jun 1982) – Salyut 7 mission (and later Soyuz TM‑7)【1】 |
| **Michel Tognini** | 30 Sep 1949 | Soyuz TM‑15 (27 Jul 1992 – 10 Aug 1992) – Mir expedition【2】 |
| **Jean‑Pierre Haignère** | 19 May 1948 | Soyuz TM‑17 (1 Jul 1993 – 22 Jul 1993) and Soyuz TM‑29 (1999) – Mir missions【3】 |

### Sources  

**Jean‑Loup Chrétien** – French astronaut, first Frenchman in space. The French‑astronauts list shows his birthdate and Soyuz T‑6 flight:  
> “Birthdate: August 20 1938 … Flights: 1. **June 24 – July 2 1982 on ‘Soyuz T‑6’**…”【1】

**Michel Tognini** – CNES spationaut. The same list records his birthdate and Soyuz TM‑15 flight:  
> “Birthdate: September 30 1949 … Flights: 1. **July 27 – August 10 1992 on ‘Soyuz TM‑15’**…”【2】

**Jean‑Pierre Haignère** – French Air Force officer and former CNES spationaut. ESA/ISSTRACKER page lists his birthdate and Soyuz missions:  
> “Birthdate: May 19 1948 … Missions: **Soyuz TM‑17** … **Soyuz TM‑29**”【3】

These three individuals satisfy all three criteria: French birth, at least one Soyuz flight, and birth before 1950. No other French‑born astronauts/flyers meet all three conditions.
